name: New Museum
hours: Thu 11am–9pm; other days generally 11–6, closed Mon–Tue — confirm at newmuseum.org/visit
notes:
Front end is a heavy JS SPA (WebFetch returned empty HTML on every path tried — main page, /press/, and the specific press-release URL) — worth checking for __NEXT_DATA__ or an API when fingerprinting for real adapter work. Multi-floor building; exact per-floor exhibition schedule not fully resolved, see manual.ts confidence. Image search (2026-08-18): installation photography is by Dario Lasagni (confirmed via web search across Warhol Foundation, Pace Gallery, and Frieze coverage of this show), but no fetchable newmuseum.org image URL was found to link — image_urls left empty rather than guessed.

Fingerprint (2026-08-18): wordpress — wp-content path in HTML, /wp-json/ unreachable.

Wired to real live adapter (2026-08-18): answers the __NEXT_DATA__ question flagged above — yes. www.newmuseum.org is a Next.js frontend for a headless WordPress+WPGraphQL backend on a separate admin.newmuseum.org subdomain (which is why /wp-json/ on the public domain 500s). The page embeds real, fully structured GraphQL-typed "Exhibition" objects with ISO startDate/endDate directly in its SSR JSON payload — no scraping heuristics needed. Correctly resolves 4 current shows (New Humans: Memories of the Future; Plaza: Sarah Lucas—VENUS VICTORIA; Facade: Tschabalala Self—Art Lovers; Atrium Stair: Klára Hosnedlová—Shelter) with real installation photos from admin.newmuseum.org, filtering out the page's embedded older/closed shows going back to 2022. No artist field on this GraphQL type, so artists stays empty rather than parsed out of title text unreliably.
